policy: Normalized signed rolling utility per horizon, weights 1–16 initially 4; update only on completed 13-tick ticket by sign agreement with 13-tick gain. All horizons need 4 samples. Positive weighted sum permits anticipation. Same inputs as 159K.
limitations: 13-tick outcome is proxy target, not global utility; its own weight always increases at settlement. Nested horizons correlated; weight bounds and normalization provisional. Synthetic paired test, not independent holdout; not physical dynamics.
